spans.s:
Bush,Ⓒs.ⒹgulmaH-lmaM, kzupaH, staMbaH; ‘why do you beat about the b(ush)’ aprastutaM kimiti anusaMDIyate, (nirarTakaM kimiti vanamAloqayasi); ‘a bird in the hand is worth two in the b(ush)’ DruvARi parityajya aDruva-nizevaRaM nezwaM, aDruvAd Druva varaM, varaM tatkAlopanatA tittiriH na punardivasAMtaritA mayUrI or varamadya kapoto na Svo mayUraH.
Ⓝ[Bush]y,Ⓒa.ⒹgulmAvfta, nibiqa; gAQa, avirala.
Ⓑ
 2 Gana, sTUla; lomaSa.

Business,Ⓒs.ⒹkAryaM, arTaH, kftyaM, karman n., vyavasAyaH, vyavahAraH; vyApAraH; niyogaH (duty).
Ⓑ
 2 arTaH, prayojanaM; ‘what b(usiness) had you to talk with him’ tena sahAlApena kiM tava kAryamAsIt.
Ⓑ
 3 vftti f., jIvikA; ‘a man of b(usiness)’ kAryakuSalaH, dfzwakarman m.

Buzz,Ⓒv. i.ⒹguMj 1 P, viru 2 P.
Ⓝ[Buzz]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹguMjitaM, guMjAravaH, kalaravaH.

Bustle,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMBramaH, AkulatvaM, tvarA, vyagratA.
Ⓑ
 2 kolAhalaH, tumularavaH.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹkAryavyApftatvAd itastato DAv 1 P or gam 1 P or cezw 1 A, or vyavaso 4 P.
Ⓝ[Bustl]er, [Bustl]ing,Ⓒs., a.ⒹcapalaprakftiH, vyavasAyin m.

Busy,Ⓒa.ⒹvyApfta (with loc.); kAryasamAkula; kAryavyagra; ‘with what work are you b(usy)’ kasminkArye vyApftosi, kimAraMBastvaM; kAryodyukta, sodyoga, ataMdrita, analasa, vyagra.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹvyApf c., kArye niyuj 10 or aDikf 8 U.
ⓃBusybody,Ⓒs.ⒹparADikAracarcakaH. // seems the entry is not having proper relation with body matter.
Ⓝ[Busi]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹataMdritaM, sotsAhaM, manoBiniveSena, Otsukyena, vyagratayA.
